title: Which advanced capability does each requirement need?
prompt: Place each requirement with the capability that satisfies it.

pairs.item: Handle approved and rejected differently after the review step.
pairs.why: Conditional branching is the documented capability for divergent paths.

pairs.item: Process every row in a returned list the same way.
pairs.why: Loops process a collection, which is an explicit competency requirement.

pairs.item: Run at 6am every weekday regardless of activity.
Run whenever the source policy document changes.
pairs.why: Event-driven runs on content changes cover this case.

takeaway: Advanced capabilities include schedule-based triggers, event-driven runs on content changes, and conditional branching and looping.
